name: @stressed-duck/agent
description: Independent Stressed Duck host and VS Code extension

scripts.simulator: npm run build --workspace @stressed-duck/host && node packages/host/dist/cli.js simulate
scripts.studio-check: npm run build --workspace @stressed-duck/host && node packages/host/dist/cli.js studio-check
scripts.mock-run: npm run build --workspace @stressed-duck/host && node packages/host/dist/cli.js mock-run
scripts.broker: npm run build --workspace @stressed-duck/host && node packages/host/dist/cli.js broker
scripts.live: npm run build --workspace @stressed-duck/host && node packages/host/dist/cli.js live
